game_status_vs_reserve_list.finding: a player absent from the weekly report is not thereby available. Reserve/injured-reserve players are not listed on the weekly report at all. No reserve-list capture exists in this repository, so 'not listed' is published as 'not listed', never as 'available'.

depth_deficiency.method: Projected starter = the lowest-ranked listed player at that slot who is not Out or Doubtful on the official report. A slot is deficient when that player is not rank 1, i.e. a backup is projected to start. Questionable is shown, never upgraded to available or downgraded to out.
limits: The starter is projected from a club depth chart, not confirmed from playing time. The brief forbids using the chart as a playing-time source, so this column is labelled 'depth-chart projected' everywhere it appears.
Slots with more than one rank-1 player (shared slots) are recorded as shared, not collapsed to one starter.
A slot whose starter is absent from a chart is a chart gap, published as a gap.

totals.clubs_without_chart_reason: Houston publishes its depth chart as an image only; the brief says an image is not an authorised structured source, so no rows are transcribed and the club is published as 'no structured chart'

reconciliation.meaning_tested: a slot is counted here when no listed player is available (3 slots: IND 1, TEN 2), AND when a backup is pressed into duty by an official designation (38 slots). The generator adds the two, so the column is not 'empty slots'.
reconciliation.chart_gap_is_separate: chart_gap_slots (1, PHI DT 'Ty Robinson (2)') is a distinct concept: a player printed with a trailing number in a rank-1 cell, i.e. the chart lists no first string. It is not part of the 41.

totals.empty_slot_note: residual 3 = slots with no available listed player: IND 1, TEN 2 (the rest of the 41 is the 38 pressed-into-duty slots)

depth_deficiency.deepest_replacement_note: Only one row is shown here because this file publishes the deepest confirmed case with its ladder; the full 38-row list is in data/depth_ladder.json's deficient_slots, which the existing Depth & Deficiency page already renders.

third_and_fourth_string.consequence: no team this week is projected to start a third-string player at any slot, which is the number that answers the brief's '2nd, 3rd or 4th string' question: the deficiency this week is second-string, not third.
third_and_fourth_string.ladder_depth_available: 0 slots list a fourth string; the deepest published ladder is second string for the clubs that have one
